title: Galleries keep to the style rules: 5 options fit
note: Since the gallery screen entry: interface colours keep to Sepulcra's palette rules by hue as well as nearest colour (no grave green or fire on a label or accent), labels count as different only 0.06 Oklab apart, and a guarded colour with no room of its own is dropped and replanned among the greys the rules allow, so the can't-afford round shows 5 that read apart and says so on its round line. Sheet headers carry the question in the UI font; onboarding steps say which of four they are.
